claim.claim-text: 1. A machine for making rod-shaped smoking articles (1), comprising:
2. The machine (1) according to claim 1, wherein the first cutting means (3) are configured for cutting the web (100) in such a way as to create a plurality of continuous longitudinal strips (101).
3. The machine (1) according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the first cutting means (3) are configured for cutting the web (100) into continuous longitudinal strips (101).

4. The machine (1) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the means (7) for making a plurality of longitudinal easy folding zones (104) are designed to make longitudinal easy folding zones (104), in particular weakening the structure of the material, configured to improve the next step of gathering and conveying the longitudinal strips (101) in the gathering and conveying means (10).
5. The machine (1) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the means (7) for making a plurality of longitudinal easy folding zones (104) are configured to make at least one between:

- longitudinal crimps arranged in such a way that each easy folding zone (104) has at least one longitudinal crimp; - score lines arranged in such a way that each easy folding zone (104) has at least one longitudinal score line.
6. The machine (1) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the means (7) for making a plurality of longitudinal easy folding zones (104) comprise at least one between:

- a plurality of crimping discs (8) configured to compress the web (100) in such a way that each easy folding zone (104) has at least one longitudinal crimp; - a plurality of reduced diameter scoring discs (9) configured to partly cut the thickness of the web (100) in such a way that each easy folding zone (104) has at least one longitudinal score line.

7. The machine (1) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the first cutting means (3) are configured in such a manner that the joining portions (103) are arranged along a succession of ideal orientation lines (Y) transverse to the longitudinal feed direction (X), in particular perpendicular to the longitudinal feed direction (X) or diagonal to the longitudinal feed direction (X).

8. The machine (1) according to any of the preceding claims 1 to 6, wherein the first cutting means (3) are configured in such a manner that the joining portions (103) transverse to the longitudinal feed direction (X) are alternated with broken cutting lines (102).

9. The machine (1) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein at least one between the first roller (4) and the second roller (5) comprises a plurality of cutting discs (6), preferably rotary, the first cutting means (3) being configured in such a way as to vary the distance between the cutting profile of each cutting disc (6) and the web (100) during rotation of the cutting discs (6) so as to make a break which defines the at least one joining portion (103) in the cutting line.

10. The machine (1) according to claim 9, wherein each cutting disc (6) has a cutting profile which, along its circumferential extension, has at least one angular stretch with an increased diameter such as to cut the web (100) as the cutting disc (6) rotates, thereby making a longitudinal cut segment (102'), and at least one angular stretch with a reduced diameter such as not to cut the web (100) as the cutting disc (6) rotates, so that the web (100) defines the at least one joining portion (103).
11. The machine (1) according to claim 10, wherein the angular stretches with reduced diameter are angularly offset from each other.

12. The machine (1) according to claim 11, wherein the angular stretches with reduced diameter are angularly offset from each other in such a way that at least one joining portion (103) is defined in each transverse section of the web (100) as the cutting discs (6) rotate.

13. The machine (1) according to any one of claims 9 to 12, wherein each cutting disc (6) is configured to make longitudinal strips (101) whose edges are defined by straight or wavy or zig-zag segments (102') alternated with at least one joining portion (103), preferably each cutting disc (6) having a straight or wavy or zig-zag cutting profile.
14. A method for making rod-shaped smoking articles, comprising the following steps:

15. The method according with claim 14, wherein the step of cutting the web (100) to create the plurality of longitudinal strips (101) is performed to create a plurality of continuous longitudinal strips (101).

16. The method according with claim 14 or 15, wherein the step of cutting the web (100) to create the plurality of longitudinal strips (101) is performed by cutting the web (100) into continuous longitudinal strips (101).

17. The method as in any of previous claims 14 to 16, wherein each longitudinal easy folding zones (104) is configured to improve the next step of gathering and conveying the longitudinal strips (101) in the gathering and conveying means (10).
18. The method as in any of previous claims 14 to 17, wherein the plurality of longitudinal easy folding zones (104) comprises at least one between:
- longitudinal crimps; - longitudinal score lines.

19. The method as in any of previous claims 14 to 18, wherein the joining portions (103) are arranged along a succession of ideal orientation lines (Y) transverse to the longitudinal feed direction (X), in particular perpendicular to the longitudinal feed direction (X) or diagonal to the longitudinal feed direction (X).
20. The method as in any of previous claims 14 to 18, wherein the joining portions (103), transversely to the longitudinal feed direction (X), are alternated with broken cutting lines (102).

21. The method as in any of previous claims 14 to 20, wherein the step of cutting the web (100) is carried out in such a manner that, for each rod-shaped smoking article, each longitudinal strip (101) is connected by at least one joining portion (103) to the longitudinal strip (101) which is transversely adjacent to it

22. A rod-shaped smoking article comprising a filling material wrapped in a paper section, wherein the filling material is formed by a plurality of longitudinal strips (101), wherein the longitudinal strips (101) extend longitudinally in the rod-shaped smoking article for the entire length of the filling material and are separated by longitudinal interrupted cutting lines so that each longitudinal strip (101) is connected by at least one joining portion (103) to the longitudinal strip (101) which is transversely adjacent to it.
23. The article of claim 22, wherein the joining portions (103) connecting together the longitudinal strips (101) are distributed along the entire length of the article.
